title: NFL Football
description:
New England Patriots at Jacksonville Jaguars
The Jacksonville Jaguars host the New England Patriots at EverBank Stadium in NFL Week 3. Jacksonville won the last meeting, 32-16, at Wembley Stadium in October 2024, and the two sides have split their last four meetings evenly.

title: NFL Football
description:
Baltimore Ravens vs. Dallas Cowboys
The Cowboys meet the Ravens in NFL Week 3 action at Maracana Stadium in Rio de Janeiro. Baltimore won the last meeting between the teams 31-13 at AT&T Stadium in August 2025, and the Ravens arrive having bounced back from an opening-week loss.
